items.title: Run deadlymaracas.com launch-readiness and monetization baseline
items.summary: Produce a bounded read-only assessment for deadlymaracas.com. The registry records a scaffold lifecycle, parked status for 123 days, active auto-renewal, site and ops capabilities only, and analytics not configured. Preserve audience, traffic, conversion, revenue, attribution, SEO, health, and cost fields as unknown unless directly evidenced.
items.requested_action: Create a timestamped assessment covering observable site status, audience and content positioning, monetization readiness, health evidence, backlog priorities, measurement boundaries, and explicit unknowns. Acceptance artifact: the completed assessment plus exactly one evidence-backed next action or blocker. Rollback/follow-up boundary: no production rollback is required because no changes are authorized; follow-up is limited to documenting that single next action or blocker. Do not deploy, modify production, change credentials or configuration, request duplicate telemetry, spend money, or claim unavailable outcomes.
